Subscribe to our mailing list using the link below. Each week, you'll get
a message with details on the upcoming talk: the
speaker, the title, the abstract, and any last minute changes to
location if necessary, plus a calendar file to add to your own
calendar for convenience.

[**Join the mailing list**](https://mailman.stanford.edu/mailman/listinfo/aida4sci-seminar)

You will get a confirmation email, and the subscription only takes effect once
you reply to it — nobody can add you to the list without your say-so. The same
page lets you leave the list or change your address later, without contacting
anyone: you basically manage stuff yourself.

The list is announcement-only: nobody but the organizers can post to
it, so there is no risk of spam, broadcasts to everyone on the list to
unsubscribe etc.

Anyone may join. You do not need a Stanford affiliation, and neither does
attending.

::: {.section-head}
Attending
:::

The seminar meets **Wednesdays, 4:30–5:30 pm** in
[CoDA E160](https://campus-map.stanford.edu/?srch=CoDA) during the academic
quarter. Talks are **in person only** — there is no remote option. No
registration is needed — just come. Students may enroll for credit under
EE 292R, PSYCH 292R, or STATS 282; see the [home page](index.qmd) for details.
